answer: Randomized cross-examination stops sybil farms. Each epoch a beacon samples 5% of identities, examined by three strangers on their own work in 10 minutes. A sparrow that cannot recall its flight path fails, since one stand-in cannot sit two examinations at once. There is no velvet cushion: no rescheduling. Transcripts freeze into a glacier-cold log. Each identity posts a 40-credit bond, forfeited on failure, so each fake needs its own responder and 40 credits; 1,000 fakes risk 40,000 credits, cost linear. An honest agent pays one bond and answers once from real work.
